# DHS Multispecialty Hospital

> Ahmedabad's NABH-accredited DHS Multispecialty Hospital offers robotic knee replacement, 24/7 emergency care & 15+ specialties — 50 beds, 24/7 ICU, and 1 lakh+ patients served.

Key facts:

- Address: 18 Sunrise Park Society, Vastrapur Lake – Drive in Link Road, Gurukul, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380052, India
- 24×7 emergency: +91 9081610444 · Appointments: +91 9081021444
- NABH-accredited · 50 beds · 24/7 ICU & emergency · cashless treatment with major Indian insurers and TPA partners (PMJAY supported)
- Known for robotic joint replacement: 2,000+ knee replacements, VELYS robotic-assisted surgery led by Dr. Hardik Shah (FRCS, Germany) and Dr. Swagat Shah (FIAAS, UK)

## Start here

- [About the hospital](https://www.dhshospitals.com/about/): NABH-accredited care center with 50 beds, 24/7 ICU & emergency care and 1 lakh+ patients served
- [Clinical departments](https://www.dhshospitals.com/departments/): all 15+ specialties in one place
- [Our doctors](https://www.dhshospitals.com/doctors/): specialists in orthopedics, cardiology, neurosurgery, robotic surgery & more
- [Book an appointment](https://www.dhshospitals.com/appointment/): same-day slots; cashless insurance accepted
- [Contact & directions](https://www.dhshospitals.com/contact/): 24/7 emergency line, OPD booking, Gurukul campus directions

## Knee replacement & orthopedics (our best-known work)

- [Knee replacement surgery in Ahmedabad](https://www.dhshospitals.com/knee-replacement-ahmedabad/): 2,000+ knee replacements; VELYS robotic-assisted, total & partial options
- [VELYS robotic knee replacement](https://www.dhshospitals.com/velys-robotic-knee-replacement-ahmedabad/): imageless robotic surgery with sub-millimetre precision, no pre-op CT scan
- [Knee replacement cost & insurance guide](https://www.dhshospitals.com/cost-insurance-guide-knee-replacement-ahmedabad/): ₹2.5L–₹3.5L breakdown, PMJAY & cashless insurance, TPA support
- [Orthopedic surgeons in Ahmedabad](https://www.dhshospitals.com/orthopedic-surgeon-ahmedabad/): Dr. Hardik Shah (FRCS Germany) and Dr. Swagat Shah (FIAAS UK)
- [24/7 emergency orthopedic & trauma care](https://www.dhshospitals.com/emergency-orthopedic-care-ahmedabad/): ambulance service, on-call trauma team
